lx_profiles.SQL: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',id,'username',username) FROM lx_profiles ORDER BY id

lx_follows.SQL: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('follower_id',follower_id,'followee_id',followee_id) FROM lx_follows ORDER BY follower_id,followee_id

lx_tweets.SQL: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',id,'seed_id',seed_id,'author_id',author_id,'content',content,'created_at',created_at,'likes',likes,'comments',comments) FROM lx_tweets ORDER BY id
